text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, gabapentin 100 mg capsules are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 115 capsules (7.1 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 82 capsules (18 days on hand). Corvale General holds 244 capsules (12.9 days on hand). All current inventory is sourced from STALLION LABORATORIES PRIVATE LIMITED (NDC 72737000503).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include gabapentin as of 2026-10-21. The Stallion Laboratories plant's last FDA inspection was classified VAI on 2024-07-12.

Our position: Supply at Corvale East is below the target threshold. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General have sufficient stock to support an internal transfer without jeopardizing their own supply.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 18 capsules of gabapentin 100 mg from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Approval required: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. If transfer is insufficient, purchase from Westminster Pharmaceuticals, LLC. Approval required: Buyer.
3. If needed, purchase from Actavis Pharma, Inc. Approval required: Buyer.
4. If needed, purchase from Amici Pharma, Inc. Approval required: Buyer.
5. If needed, purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC. Approval required: Buyer.

Not recommended: No action, as Corvale East would remain below target days on hand.
